H5700.def: from «05695»; vituline; Eglon, the name of a place in Palestine and of a Moabitish king:--Eglon.

H5701.def: a primitive root; to be sad:--grieve.

H5702.def: a primitive root; to debar, i.e. from marriage:--stay.

H5703.def: from «05710»; properly, a (peremptory) terminus, i.e. (by implication) duration, in the sense of advance or perpetuity (substantially as a noun, either with or without a preposition):--eternity, ever(- lasting, -more), old, perpetually, + world without end.

H5704.et: properly, the same as (05703) (used as prep, adv or conj)
H5704.def: properly, the same as «05703» (used as a preposition, adverb or conjunction; especially with a preposition); as far (or long, or much) as, whether of space (even unto) or time (during, while, until) or degree (equally with):--against, and, as, at, before, by (that), even (to), for(-asmuch as), (hither-)to, + how long, into, as long (much) as, (so) that, till, toward, until, when, while, (+ as) yet.

H5705.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «05704»; × and, at, for, (hither-)to, on till, (un-)to, until, within.

H5706.et: the same as (05703) in the sense of the aim of an attack
H5706.def: the same as «05703» in the sense of the aim of an attack; booty:--prey.

H5707.def: contracted from «05749» ; concretely, a witness; abstractly, testimony; specifically, a recorder, i.e. prince:--witness.

H5708.et: from an unused root meaning to set a period [compare (05710), (05749)]
H5708.def: from an unused root meaning to set a period (compare «05710», «05749»); the menstrual flux (as periodical); by implication (in plural) soiling:--filthy.

H5709.def: (Aramaic) or adah (Aramaic) {ad-aw'}; corresponding to «05710»:--alter, depart, pass (away), remove, take (away).

H5710.def: a primitive root; to advance, i.e. pass on or continue; causatively, to remove; specifically, to bedeck (i.e. bring an ornament upon):--adorn, deck (self), pass by, take away.

H5711.def: from «05710»; ornament; Adah, the name of two women:--Adah.

H5712.et: from (05707) in the original sense of fixture
H5712.def: feminine of «05707» in the original sense of fixture; a stated assemblage (specifically, a concourse, or generally, a family or crowd):--assembly, company, congregation, multitude, people, swarm. Compare «05713».

H5713.def: feminine of «05707» in its techn. sense; testimony:-- testimony, witness. Compare «05712».

H5714.def: or iIddowo {id-do'}; or tIddiy {id-dee'}; from «05710»; timely; Iddo (or Iddi), the name of five Israelites:--Iddo. Compare «03035», «03260».

H5716.et: from (05710) in the sense of trappings
H5716.def: from «05710» in the sense of trappings; finery; generally an outfit; specifically, a headstall:--X excellent, mouth, ornament.

H5717.def: from «05716» and «0410»; ornament of God; Adiel, the name of three Israelites:--Adiel.

H5718.def: or mAdayahuw {ad-aw-yaw'-hoo}; from «05710» and «03050»; Jah has adorned; Adajah, the name of eight Israelites:--Adaiah.

H5720.def: the same as «05719»; Adin, the name of two Israelites:--Adin.

H5722.et: probably from (05719) in the original sense of slender (ie spear)
H5722.def: probably from «05719» in the original sense of slender (i.e. a spear); his spear:--Adino.

H5723.def: dual of a feminine of «05706»; double prey; Adithajim, a place in Palestine:--Adithaim.

H5724.et: probably from an unused root of uncertain meaning
H5724.def: probably from an unused root of uncertain meaning; Adlai, an Israelite:--Adlai.

H5725.et: probably from the pass. part. of the same as (05724)
H5725.def: probably from the passive participle of the same as «05724»; Adullam, a place in Palestine:--Adullam.

H5726.def: patrial from «05725»; an Adullamite or native of Adullam:--Adullamite.

H5727.def: a primitive root; to be soft or pleasant; figuratively and reflexively, to live voluptuously:--delight self.

H5728.def: or radennah {ad-en'-naw}; from «05704» and «02004»; till now:--yet.

H5729.def: from «05727»; pleasure; Eden, a place in Mesopotamia:--Eden.

H5730.def: or (feminine) aednah {ed-naw'}; from «05727»; pleasure:--delicate, delight, pleasure. See also «01040».

H5731.def: the same as «05730» (masculine); Eden, the region of Adam's home:--Eden.

H5732.et: from a root corresponding to that of (05708)
H5732.def: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to that of «05708»; a set time; technically, a year:--time.

H5733.def: from «05727»; pleasure; Adna, the name of two Israelites:--Adna.

H5734.def: from «05727»; pleasure; Adnah, the name of two Israelites:--Adnah.

H5735.def: from «05712»; festival; Adadah, a place in Palestine:--Adadah.

H5736.def: a primitive root; to be (causatively, have) redundant:--be more, odd number, be (have) over (and above), overplus, remain.

H5737.def: a primitive root; to arrange, as a battle, a vineyard (to hoe); hence, to muster and so to miss (or find wanting):--dig, fail, keep (rank), lack.

H5738.def: from «05737»; an arrangement (i.e. drove); Eder, an Israelite:--Ader.

H5739.def: from «05737»; an arrangement, i.e. muster (of animals):--drove, flock, herd.

H5740.def: the same as «05739»; Eder, the name of an Israelite and of two places in Palestine:--Edar, Eder.

H5741.def: from «05739» and «0410»; flock of God; Adriel, an Israelite:--Adriel.

H5742.et: from an unused root of uncertain meaning
H5742.def: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; a lentil:--lentile.

H5743.def: a primitive root; to be dense or dark, i.e. to becloud:--cover with a cloud.

H5744.def: active participle of «05647»; serving; Obed, the name of five Israelites:--Obed.

H5745.def: of foreign derivation; Obal, a son of Joktan:--Obal.

H5746.def: a primitive root; properly, to gyrate; but used only as a denominative from «05692», to bake (round cakes on the hearth):--bake.

H5747.def: probably from «05746»; round; Og, a king of Bashan:--Og.

H5748.et: from (05689) in the original sense of breathing
H5748.def: or buggab {oog-gawb'}; from «05689» in the original sense of breathing; a reed-instrument of music:--organ.

H5749.def: a primitive root; to duplicate or repeat; by implication, to protest, testify (as by reiteration); intensively, to encompass, restore (as a sort of reduplication):--admonish, charge, earnestly, lift up, protest, call (take) to record, relieve, rob, solemnly, stand upright, testify, give warning, (bear, call to, give, take to) witness.

H5750.def: or rod {ode}; from «05749»; properly, iteration or continuance; used only adverbially (with or without preposition), again, repeatedly, still, more:--again, × all life long, at all, besides, but, else, further(-more), henceforth, (any) longer, (any) more(-over), × once, since, (be) still, when, (good, the) while (having being), (as, because, whether, while) yet (within).

H5752.def: or mOded {o-dade'}; from «05749»; reiteration; Oded, the name of two Israelites:--Oded.

H5753.def: a primitive root; to crook, literally or figuratively (as follows):--do amiss, bow down, make crooked, commit iniquity, pervert, (do) perverse(-ly), trouble, × turn, do wickedly, do wrong.

H5755.def: or eAvvae (2 Kings 17:24) {av-vaw'}; for «05754»; Ivvah or Avva, a region of Assyria:--Ava, Ivah.

H5756.def: a primitive root; to be strong; causatively, to stregthen, i.e. (figuratively) to save (by flight):--gather (self, self to flee), retire.

H5757.def: patrial from «05755»; an Avvite or native of Avvah (only plural):--Avims, Avites.

H5758.def: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to «05753»; perverseness:--iniquity.

H5759.def: from «05764»; a babe:--young child, little one.

H5761.def: plural of «05757»; Avvim (as inhabited by Avvites), a place in Palestine (with the article prefix):--Avim.

H5762.def: or (perhaps Ayowth {ah-yoth'}, as if plural of «05857») cAyuwth {ah-yoth'}; from «05753»; ruin; Avvith (or Avvoth), a place in Palestine:--Avith.

H5763.def: a primitive root; to suckle, i.e. give milk:--milch, (ewe great) with young.

H5765.def: a primitive root; to distort (morally):--deal unjustly, unrighteous.

H5766.def: or lavel {aw'-vel}; and (feminine) lavlah {av-law'}; or owlah {o-law'}; or .olah {o-law'}; from «05765»; (moral) evil:--iniquity, perverseness, unjust(-ly), unrighteousness(-ly); wicked(-ness).

H5768.def: or lolal {o-lawl'}; from «05763»; a suckling:--babe, (young) child, infant, little one.

H5769.def: or lolam {o-lawm'}; from «05956»; properly, concealed, i.e. the vanishing point; generally, time out of mind (past or future), i.e. (practically) eternity; frequentatively, adverbial (especially with prepositional prefix) always:--alway(-s), ancient (time), any more, continuance, eternal, (for, (n-))ever(-lasting, -more, of old), lasting, long (time), (of) old (time), perpetual, at any time, (beginning of the) world (+ without end). Compare «05331», «05703».

H5771.def: or oavown (2 Kings «07»:9; Psalm 51:5 («07»)) {aw-vone'}; from «05753»; perversity, i.e. (moral) evil:--fault, iniquity, mischeif, punishment (of iniquity), sin.

H5772.et: from an unused root apparently meaning to dwell together
H5772.def: from an unused root apparently meaning to dwell together; sexual (cohabitation):--duty of marriage.

H5774.def: a primitive root; to cover (with wings or obscurity); hence (as denominative from «05775») to fly; also (by implication of dimness) to faint (from the darkness of swooning):--brandish, be (wax) faint, flee away, fly (away), × set, shine forth, weary.

H5775.def: from «05774»; a bird (as covered with feathers, or rather as covering with wings), often collectively:--bird, that flieth, flying, fowl.

H5777.def: or mophereth {o-feh'-reth}; feminine participle active of «06080»; lead (from its dusty color):--lead.

H5778.def: from «05775»; birdlike; Ephai, an Israelite:--Ephai (from margin).

H5779.def: a primitive root; to consult:--take advice ((counsel) together).

H5780.def: apparently from «05779»; consultation; Uts, a son of Aram, also a Seirite, and the regions settled by them.:--Uz.

H5781.def: a primitive root; to pack:--be pressed.

H5782.et: a primitive root [rather identical with (05783) through the idea of opening the eyes]
H5782.def: a primitive root (rather identical with «05783» through the idea of opening the eyes); to wake (literally or figuratively):--(a- )wake(-n, up), lift up (self), × master, raise (up), stir up (self).

H5783.def: a primitive root; to (be) bare:--be made naked.

H5785.def: from «05783»; skin (as naked); by implication, hide, leather:--hide, leather, skin.

H5786.et: a primitive root [rather denominatively from (05785) through the idea of a film over the eyes]
H5786.def: a primitive root (rather denominatively from «05785» through the idea of a film over the eyes); to blind:--blind, put out. See also «05895».

H5787.def: intensive from «05786»; blind (literally or figuratively):--blind (men, people).

H5789.def: a primitive root; to hasten:--assemble self.

H5790.def: for «05789»; to hasten, i.e. succor:--speak in season.

H5791.def: a primitive root; to wrest:--bow self, (make) crooked., falsifying, overthrow, deal perversely, pervert, subvert, turn upside down.

H5793.def: from «05790»; succoring; Uthai, the name of two Israelites:--Uthai.

H5794.def: from «05810»; strong, vehement, harsh:--fierce, + greedy, mighty, power, roughly, strong.

H5795.def: from «05810»; a she-goat (as strong), but masculine in plural (which also is used ellipt. for goat's hair):--(she) goat, kid.

H5797.def: or (fully) rowz {oze}; from «05810»; strength in various applications (force, security, majesty, praise):--boldness, loud, might, power, strength, strong.

H5798.def: or (Uzzah {ooz-zaw'}; feminine of «05797»; strength; Uzza or Uzzah, the name of five Israelites:--Uzza, Uzzah.

H5799.def: from «05795» and «0235»; goat of departure; the scapegoat:--scapegoat.
